violated_contract: Client telemetry volume must be a monitored budget line, not an unbounded cost. Between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-12 the Omi fleet's PostHog event volume doubled (1.02M -> 1.89M events/day) from two routine PRs (#20462 pendant 10s drain, #20378 ingress health event) while daily users stayed flat, driving a projected $7.5k/period bill; the existing weekly unique-people alerts cannot see volume-without-users, the warehouse backfill billed $1.7k across a period boundary with no alarm, and no script read PostHog's billing meter on a schedule, so the cost step was found five days late in a manual review.
canonical_prevention: Freeze a telemetry transport contract before moving or adding emitters; default every migration/retirement flag OFF; rate-limit emitters at the source (per-attempt upload events, deduped ingress-state transitions); alert on billing-meter usage deltas against a same-weekday median plus absolute floors, on per-day spend, and on the period projection against a budget; and require a capacity regression test proving aggregate storage cannot fill a single document.
